description: This file defines classes and methods for parsing and handling sections of a kickstart file, including script sections, package sections, and certificate sections, with support for version-specific options and deprecation warnings.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Base class for defining kickstart file sections, providing common handling for header, line, and visibility.

classes.name: NullSection
classes.description: A section class that recognizes but ignores its content, useful for skipping unknown sections.

classes.name: ScriptSection
classes.description: Handles script sections (%pre, %post, etc.) with support for scripting language, logging, and error handling.

classes.name: PreScriptSection
classes.description: Represents a %pre script section, used for commands run immediately after parsing.

classes.name: PreInstallScriptSection
classes.description: Represents a %pre-install script section, used for commands after partitioning and filesystem creation.

classes.name: PostScriptSection
classes.description: Represents a %post script section, used for commands after installation completes, with chroot options.

classes.name: OnErrorScriptSection
classes.description: Handles %onerror sections, executed on fatal errors during installation.

classes.name: TracebackScriptSection
classes.description: Handles %traceback sections, executed on internal Python errors, deprecated in favor of %onerror.

classes.name: PackageSection
classes.description: Handles the %packages section, parsing package and group specifications with version-specific options.

classes.name: CertificateSection
classes.description: Handles %certificate sections, managing certificate content and installation parameters.

methods.name: handleHeader
methods.description: Processes section header arguments, sets internal state, and handles version-specific options.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Processes individual lines within a section, appending to internal buffers or data structures.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes processing of a section, creating objects or validating content.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser configured for the section type.

methods.name: _resetScript
methods.description: Resets the internal script data structure to default values.
